subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should OpenClaw ship `outputSchema` now as a public plugin SDK contract with fail-closed validation for opted-in catalog calls?
rationale: The implementation is additive and well-proven, but exposing this field through the shipped SDK establishes a durable third-party contract whose future schema and error semantics require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Accept the trusted-only API and validation semantics after the two review findings are fixed and compatibility-focused tests remain green.

options.title: Keep output schemas internal
options.body: Limit declared output schemas to core-owned tools until a separate plugin SDK contract is reviewed and documented.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers decide schema support, failure envelopes, and long-term deprecation expectations in a dedicated design discussion.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Accept the trusted-only API and validation semantics after the two review findings are fixed and compatibility-focused tests remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged feature history identifies `steipete` as the clearest owner of the Code Mode performance and catalog-contract direction.
